newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks remain lower in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks remain lower in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices remained down but off their early lows in late Monday trade on fears over deteriorating law and order and political instability, brokers said.
With 45 minutes left, the weighted index had fallen by 47.45 points, or 0.57 percent, to 8,267.22. Turnover was T$58.6 billion.
"The political issues have dominated market sentiment. People are either taking profits or stepping to the sidelines," said Michael Chien, an analyst of China Securities.
Student groups protested in Taipei to demand the resignation of Premier Lien Chan after a mass demonstration on Sunday against the government's failure to check a spate of violent crimes.
The National Assembly convened on Monday to discuss constitutional reforms on island.
Electronics lost 0.40 percent, but motherboard maker Asustek soared by the daily seven percent limit to T$357 on its ex-bonus issue day.
